summary: FS KKR Capital Corp. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its Loan and Servicing Agreement. A wholly-owned subsidiary, CCT Tokyo Funding LLC, extended the maturity date of its loan facility from June 2, 2026 to September 30, 2026. This is a routine credit agreement amendment that does not involve a change of control, special distribution, or strategic restructuring. The filing does not qualify as a special situation; it is merely a material definitive agreement update. No deal terms are provided beyond the maturity extension.
